## [3.0.0](https://github.com/awinogradov/code-assistants/compare/agents-skills-sync-action@v2.0.0...agents-skills-sync-action@v3.0.0) (2026-09-18)

## Release Notes

Autopilot skills drop Graphify and Repomix as context sources entirely — all codebase context now flows through `Grep`, `Glob`, `Read`, and `git` only.

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

### Graphify and Repomix context tiers removed from autopilot skills

All skills that previously queried a Graphify graph or attached a Repomix pack for context acquisition no longer do so. After syncing this release into `.agents/skills/`, any workflow that relied on `Bash(graphify …)` or `MCP(repomix:*)` calls within autopilot skill execution will break — those entries are gone from every skill's `allowed-tools`. Follow the plugin's [MIGRATING.md](https://github.com/awinogradov/code-assistants/blob/main/claude-plugins/autopilot/MIGRATING.md) section **9.0.1 → 10.0.0** to update.

Migration steps:

1. Remove any `Bash(graphify …)` and `mcp__repomix__*` entries from your local `allowed-tools` overrides or wrapper workflows.
2. Remove `MCP(repomix:*)` from the code-review action's allowed tools if you extended it.
3. Delete any `context-source:`, `graphify-trace:`, `graphify-shortlist:`, and `context-fallback:` records from plan templates or Context Map configurations.
4. Remove the `## Context source` section from any plan templates that mirror the autopilot layout.
5. Remove the `**Snapshot**` field from any Context Map documents that mirror the autopilot layout.
6. Re-run the sync action — the updated skills will use `Grep`/`Glob`/`Read`/`git` for all context needs.
